mapper.sql: select analysis_id, session_id, user_id, chat_name, goal, start_time, end_time, message_id_from, message_id_to, message_count, identity_desc, refs_used, result_json, crisis, crisis_message, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, duration_ms, status, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time from sys_wechat_analysis
mapper.insert: insert into sys_wechat_analysis ( session_id, user_id, chat_name, goal, start_time, end_time, message_id_from, message_id_to, message_count, identity_desc, refs_used, result_json, prompt_snapshot, crisis, crisis_message, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, duration_ms, status, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{chatName}, #{goal}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{messageIdFrom}, #{messageIdTo}, #{messageCount}, #{identityDesc}, #{refsUsed}, #{resultJson}, #{promptSnapshot}, #{crisis}, #{crisisMessage}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select analysis_id, session_id, user_id, chat_name, goal, start_time, end_time, message_id_from, message_id_to, message_count, identity_desc, refs_used, result_json, crisis, crisis_message, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, duration_ms, status, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time from sys_wechat_analysis where session_id = #{sessionId} and del_flag = '0' order by analysis_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update sys_wechat_analysis set del_flag = '2' where session_id = #{sessionId} and del_flag = '0'
